ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45:55 ratio of high-intensity white to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface, characterized by high local contrast at pigmentation boundaries.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe contains heavy, dendritic black mottling and irregular streaks over a white base; right lobe displays a finer stippled black pattern on a white base; central region is a solid, low-intensity black triangular mass extending from the peduncle.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 45 degrees and a high depth-to-width ratio.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge of both lobes, creating a jagged boundary against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly concave curvature sweeping from the tapered distal tips inward toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct cluster of high-intensity white circular pixel clusters (barnacle scars) localized on the extreme distal tip of the right lobe; smaller white punctate spots scattered across the central black region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned, low-intensity linear streaks (rake marks) cutting through the high-intensity white pigmentation on the left lobe, oriented primarily from the anterior toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible white barnacle colonization or localized scarring cluster on the right lobe tip; irregular jagged trailing edge indicates minor historical tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced pigmentation asymmetry between the left and right fluke lobes.
